Theme

Latin word

lēx

lēx, lēgis f.

noun, third declension

condition, terms (of an agreement); a law; in the plural, the laws; a rule, a regulation; a condition

In this lexicon

  • condition

    also used · classical · Ter. Eun. 102: hāc lēge tibi meam adstringō fidem; Traupman 95: eā lēge ut

  • law

    the recommended word · classical · Tac. Germ. 19.5: bonae lēgēs; Traupman 178, 179, 180, 195; Traupman 195: against the law, contrā lēgem; by law, lēge

  • rule

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Amic. 44: haec igitur prīma lēx amīcitiae sanciātur; Cic. Amic. 40 (Lewis & Short)
